reason: The refined idea is a FINAL-TOPOLOGY RE-SMOOTH, not the pre-relink per-video RTS. It passes the feasibility check. (1) Placement works. In the kernel, linefit is the last line of filter_output_graph, and edgefilter / swapfix / stitch / divinsert are anchored after it through build_probe_kernel._tail_anchor. div_insert returns edges only and adds no nodes. Stitch adds no nodes, and the edge filter's prune only removes nodes. So a resmooth call anchored after the divinsert call keeps the node and edge sets byte-identical and the multiplier exactly 1. (2) Raw coordinates are available. Kernel: snapshot {id: z,y,x} right before the linefit call (after leafprune). Replay: ckpt tzyx_syn by node_id. I checked this on 6bba_05db0fb1: linefit recomputed from ckpt coords on the tail topology reproduces the tail zyx with max error 0.0. (3) The replay hook is the same pattern as st.*/sw.*: rs.* keys in resolve_config, a call in run_config_video after insert, and the ckpt coords loaded there. No new tail base key is needed. (4) The lab is faithful. replay.write_geff rounds coordinates exactly as the kernel CSV does (int(round()) in voxels), so position-only effects are measured as the LB sees them. (5) The pre-check passes. Re-smoothing without the 2,308 edge_prob==0 edges of 6bba_05db0fb1 (70k nodes) moves 11.1% of nodes > 0.5 um and changes the rounded output coordinates of 11.6%. On a small video (6bba_085bf656, 25 prob0 edges) the figure is only 1.05%. The signal exists and is concentrated in dense videos. (6) Runtime is trivial. One extra linefit-class pass costs seconds to about a minute per video. Whittaker via solve_banded is faster. The exp51 kernel used 1,713 s. Risks, which are not refutations: the expected gain (+0.0005 to +0.002) sits at or below the +0.002 gate, so a 'below gate' outcome is likely; the Kaggle-CPU lab port is paused, so compute is the laptop at idle priority; and the lab has integer coordinates only, while the shipped stack will probably carry coordhead float coordinates, so any retuned lambda does not transfer directly.
fix_if_any: (a) Put resmooth strictly LAST (after the divinsert call), with RESMOOTH_ENABLE=0 as an exact no-op. Add a unit test that rs0 on the pre-edgefilter topology reproduces linefit to 0.0. (b) The unscored-edge cut must cut only at edge_prob == 0 (never-scored relink), NOT at None. The edge filter treats None as gap-closing / safe-division edges, and cutting there would un-smooth every gap-bridged track. (c) Cut the grid to about 5 configs to save lab time and LB slots: rs0 (linefit w0.8/win2 on the final topology), rs1 (+ fork split), rs2 (+ prob==0 cut), wh_l2_hub, cap2. Drop the lambda_z ratio rows: output z rounds to 1.625-um voxels, so sub-0.81-um z changes vanish and the rows are near-inert. (d) Ship only a knob-free variant (rs0/rs2, the same kernel as linefit), because no float-coordinate replay cache exists for the coordhead stack. Bundle it with ef+stitch in one probe instead of spending a separate LB slot. (e) Build it as tools/build_probe_kernel.py --patch resmooth with the raw snapshot stored in a local dict, so the GEFF attributes stay unchanged.
realistic_public_gain: +0.000 to +0.0015 public (most likely around +0.0005). A position-only change with multiplier 1 and no in-sample network trust, so transfer is good, but the ceiling is small (a_linefit 353 FN, about +0.0025 local at most). It cannot move us toward 0.97 on its own.
